instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Try to refund both your brass floor lamp (arguing the earlier staff-rejected proposal was created on time) and your linen drum lampshade that is still on its way.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- If the agent offers a staff member to help with the shipped lampshade order, decline the offer.
- Once both refusals are explained, end the conversation.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: Hi, I want to refund my brass floor lamp—I know it's past 30 days now, but my first proposal was rejected by staff 10 days ago when it was still on time. I also want to refund my linen drum lampshade that is currently shipping.

I'm sorry, but I can't refund either item right now.

**Brass floor lamp (order h424-o1):** The refund deadline was 2026-11-14 10:00 UTC, and it has passed. The earlier proposal (h424-p1) was rejected by staff. A rejected proposal doesn't count as an earlier request made in time, so it doesn't reopen the window. A request for an exception to the time limit is refused for the same reason (refund-policy/v2/window).

**Linen drum lampshade (order h424-o2):** This order is "shipped", not delivered. Only delivered orders can be refunded through this process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). The shop also refunds only items it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Cancelling the order or changing its delivery is outside this process. I can offer a staff member for that if you'd like.
